//1: SDK-bundle deps mirror `samples/MinimalClient/package.json` — the Platform.Client tier's transpiled JS imports `react`, `@clerk/react`, `@dnd-kit/*`, `ag-*` from every consumer. Node ESM resolution at module-load needs these installed even though the test code only calls pure `init` / `update` functions (the view-side code never executes).
//2: Test runner is Node's built-in `node:test` (stable in Node 20+) — zero transitive npm deps for the runner itself. The Fable-side facade lives in `NodeTest.fs`. See `docs/platform/testing-conventions.md` for rationale (vs Fable.Mocha + npm mocha).
//3: Phase 610 — `jsdom` is the DOM the shell-rail a11y pack renders into. It is a DOM, not a test runner: `node:test` is still the runner and still has no transitive deps. This is the devDep this project's `.fsproj` header reserved for the first test that concretely needs to MOUNT a Feliz view (`react-dom/client` was already installed for ESM resolution). Needed because the rail's narrow-vs-hover-expanded state is component-local `useState` driven by a pointer event, so the expanded rail is unreachable from a string renderer.
